title: Founding of Tubigon
description: The settlement was originally established as 'Tubigon' owing to its coastal streams and fertile lands along the Antique shoreline.

title: Named San Jose de Buenavista
description: Spanish Governor Agustín Sumugod officially renamed the pueblo 'San Jose de Buenavista' in honor of Saint Joseph and the beautiful coastal view.

title: Capital of Antique
description: San Jose de Buenavista was designated as the provincial capital of Antique, taking over administrative governance from Bugasong.

title: Revolutionary Stance
description: General Leandro Fullon landed in Antique and liberated San Jose de Buenavista, establishing the revolutionary government in Panay.

title: World War II Liberation
description: Filipino guerilla forces alongside Allied troops liberated San Jose de Buenavista from occupying forces, restoring municipal governance.

title: Provincial Economic Hub
description: San Jose de Buenavista flourishes as the commercial, financial, educational, and administrative heart of Antique Province.
